Supplying, installation, testing and commissioning of Central Processor Unit Module, Mounts to local rail at a dedicated location. Takes two local rail module spaces. Supports 3-LCD(XL), 3-RS485A/B/R, 3-RS232 complete as required. (3-CPU3)
:selected:

Supplying, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Large Format Liquid Crystal Display Module. Mounts to 3-CPU(1/3). Requires 4 control/display spaces on operator layer Complete as required. (3-LCDXL1)

Reprogramming of existing 2 Loop Addressable Fire Alarm Control Panel, including verification of all existing devices, modification of loop configuration as per revised site layout, updating of cause and effect matrix, uploading and downloading of new program through compatible software, testing and commissioning of the complete system to ensure proper functionality of all loops, devices, and interfacing modules. All tools, software, and technical manpower complete as required.
Supplying & laying of 2x1.5 sq.mm fire alarm armored cable, 600/1000V rated with annealed copper conductor having XLPE insulation, steel wire armoring & FRLS outer sheath complete as required.
Supplying, installation, testing & commissioning of intelligent analog addressable photo thermal detector complete with mounting base complete as required.
